name: Shanghai New Centurion Network Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai New Centurion Network Information Technology Co., Ltd. provides IT data center operation and maintenance products and services in China. The company offers ZnAiops intelligent operation and management, automated operation and maintenance management, agile ITSM service management, unified intelligent monitoring, big data log analysis, application release management, CMDB IT asset management, and an intelligent middle platform, as well as an operation and maintenance brain, a panoramic observation solution. It also provides database ecosystem services, such as ZnSQL heterogeneous database intelligent management platform, SQL audit management platform, integrated batch processing data platform, data governance platform, data visualization, data asset management, NewSQL database cloud management platform, and domestic IT database solutions. In addition, the company offers fintech digital employee solutions, digital operations and maintenance solutions for the financial industry, SRE operation and maintenance solutions for the insurance industry, unified operation and maintenance solutions for large enterprises, enhancing IT service capabilities in smart manufacturing, smart campus solutions, cloud migration solutions, DevOps solutions, and data center emergency switchover solutions. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
